#!/bin/bash
# E03 STDN SCIENTIFIC seed 2026 -- tmux session e03_stdn_seed2026. Exact tools/run_e03.py launch contract (docstring).
date -u +%FT%TZ > /home/student20261/workdir/e03_s2026.launch_time
cd /home/student20261/workdir/GPAT_TransferBench || { echo 97 > /home/student20261/workdir/e03_s2026.exit; exit 97; }
env PATH=/home/student20261/miniconda3/envs/gpat-m6-e03/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin \
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 TF_ENABLE_AUTO_MIXED_PRECISION=0 \
    TF_ENABLE_AUTO_MIXED_PRECISION_GRAPH_REWRITE=0 TF_ENABLE_CUBLAS_TENSOR_OP_MATH_FP32=0 \
    TF_ENABLE_CUDNN_TENSOR_OP_MATH_FP32=0 TF_ENABLE_CUDNN_RNN_TENSOR_OP_MATH_FP32=0 TF_XLA_FLAGS=--tf_xla_auto_jit=0 \
    TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS=1 TF_CUDNN_DETERMINISTIC=1 CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 TF_ENABLE_ONEDNN_OPTS=0 \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=2026 \
    python -u -B tools/run_e03.py --seed 2026 --execution-config configs/execution/m5_gpu_3090.yaml
echo $? > /home/student20261/workdir/e03_s2026.exit
date -u +%FT%TZ > /home/student20261/workdir/e03_s2026.end_time
